title: triumph of st. Katherine — Reflection of Kiki-Jiki targeting Triumph of St. Katherine hangs resolving the dies trigger

server.source: isolated v0.104.0 single-user server on 127.0.0.1:9374 (runs/20261008-7156; ServerHello verified v0.104.0/4227122/protocol 118) + verified pin (minisign-verify of binary + signed data manifest with the repo-pinned key).

scope: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker saga -> transform into Reflection of Kiki-Jiki -> {1},{T} copy of Triumph of Saint Katherine -> end-step sacrifice -> dies-trigger pile resolution; native engine, two human-client seats
assertion_notes: A1: triumph chain + reflection copy/sacrifice + fable ch.III transform parse: passed (v0.104.0 card-data)
A2: reflection untapped=True triumph_on_bf=True untapped_lands>=1 turn>transform_turn: passed (pre_activation.json)
A3: target prompt answered with Triumph (oid=14, one of 2 candidates); token oid=126 on BF turn 11: passed

A4: dies trigger NOT observed on the stack and NO EffectZoneChoice was ever presented (wf types seen: MiracleReveal, OptionalEffectChoice, Priority, TargetSelection). HOWEVER post-state evidence proves the trigger's first effect executed: the exact 6 cards on top of the library at token creation (Plains, Mountain, Triumph, Triumph, Fable of Saint Katherine..., Plains) are stranded in exile in post_no_trigger.json, and the token object is gone entirely. The engine silently executed ExileTop-6 and never ran Shuffle/PutAtLibraryPosition: failed (not observed per contract; effect evidence below)
A5: no hang — the game advanced normally (turn 11 -> 29, stack empty, priority passing); the failure mode is a SILENTLY INCOMPLETE resolution, not a softlock: passed (with stranded pile)

A6: pile stranded: post exile = [Plains(22), Fable(30), Triumph(43), Mountain(48), Plains(56), Triumph(7)] — exactly the mid_token top-6 multiset; library 48 -> 33 (6 exiled + draws over turns 11-29); pile never shuffled back on top; token absent (ceased to exist): failed
A7: stack empty, game advanced to turn 29; no hang watchdog trip: passed
verdict rule: reproduced (done_reason=token died, dies trigger never fired per driver observation; evidence shows trigger fired silently and stranded the 6-card pile) zone_choice_seen=False

ADDENDUM 2026-10-08: v0.104.0 failure differs from v0.82.0 (spurious EffectZoneChoice + 5 cards stranded after answering). On v0.104.0 the dies trigger fires with NO choice prompt and NO stack observation; it exiles the token + top six, then stops — the pile is never shuffled back on top. Same bug family (Praesidium Protectiva pile resolution broken), new silent failure mode.

limitations: Browser UI not exercised; native engine via two human-client seats.
Dense playsets are a test-harness convenience (engine accepts >4-of for custom games).
The prebuilt server has no standalone state-restore; states are authoritative exports (restorable only via full game replay).
P1 fully passive (60x Plains; plays land, never casts/attacks/blocks).
The reported Discord attachment (turn-17 game state zip) was not used: its signed URL expired; the fixture replays the reported sequence from a fresh game instead.

A4 stack observation: the driver's 20Hz polling never saw the TriggeredAbility; the trigger's firing is inferred from its ExileTop-6 effect (exact top-6 cards stranded in exile). The token's zone-None disappearance is consistent with a token ceasing to exist after the ChangeZone.
